channel_targets:

- rust
target_platform:

about.description:
boast gathers reach metrics -- downloads, citations, GitHub stars, and field-standing
percentiles -- for a research tool or paper across Code, Downloads, Citations, and
Attention categories, from a curated set of pluggable providers (GitHub, crates.io,
PyPI, Homebrew, Bioconda, OpenAlex, Crossref, Dimensions, Europe PMC, Wikipedia, and
Altmetric). It records them in a durable, timestamped Snapshot with full provenance,
and renders grant-ready Reports (terminal, Markdown, and an auto-written prose
sentence) -- built for evidence-backed, reproducible statements about a tool's
impact, such as in a grant proposal.
about.summary: A reproducible research-impact aggregator for research software and papers

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.6.0"

package:
  name: boast
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/mbhall88/boast/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 57c473796bf9754c1166581ca05c99b46b6cb17114238fd77f1338e3a17d290b

build:
  number: 0

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-auditable

tests:
  - script: boast --help
  - package_contents:
      bin:
        - boast
      strict: true
about:
  homepage: https://github.com/mbhall88/boast
  repository: https://github.com/mbhall88/boast
  documentation: https://mbhall88.github.io/boast/
  summary: A reproducible research-impact aggregator for research software and papers
  description: |
    boast gathers reach metrics -- downloads, citations, GitHub stars, and field-standing
    percentiles -- for a research tool or paper across Code, Downloads, Citations, and
    Attention categories, from a curated set of pluggable providers (GitHub, crates.io,
    PyPI, Homebrew, Bioconda, OpenAlex, Crossref, Dimensions, Europe PMC, Wikipedia, and
    Altmetric). It records them in a durable, timestamped Snapshot with full provenance,
    and renders grant-ready Reports (terminal, Markdown, and an auto-written prose
    sentence) -- built for evidence-backed, reproducible statements about a tool's
    impact, such as in a grant proposal.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - mbhall88
